findings.description: A six-bedroom Edwardian at 3460 Clay Street in Presidio Heights, built around 1900 and roughly 5,230 square feet, sold in September 2026 for $14.7 million against an $11 million asking price — about $2,811 a square foot. The house last sold in 2019 for $9.1 million. The article's lede photo, captioned 400 McAllister St., is an unrelated stock image and is not evidence about this building.
